post.description: Unauthenticated; the request must carry a valid signature for the endpoint's verifier. Unknown or disabled endpoints answer 404. Invalid signatures and timestamps outside the tolerance answer 401 (signature_missing, signature_malformed, signature_invalid, timestamp_out_of_tolerance) and nothing is stored. A repeated provider event id answers 200 duplicate and starts nothing. Bodies are limited to 1 MiB; requests are rate-limited per endpoint.

post.description: Deliveries are signed with Standard Webhooks headers using the whsec_ secret returned once in `secret`. Failed deliveries retry after 30s, 2m, 10m, 30m, 2h, 6h and 12h, then are dead-lettered.

delete.description: Removes the subscription and its delivery log; pending deliveries are dropped.

patch.description: Re-enabling a subscription that was disabled after failing for 5 days clears its failure streak.

post.description: Enqueues a webhook.ping delivery to the subscription.
Pending retries are signed with the new secret. The secret is returned once in `secret`.

Senders POST to /hooks/{public_id}. For standard_webhooks, hmac_sha256 and the n8n/make/zapier token presets (sent in X-Hugi-Token) the secret is generated when omitted and returned once in `secret`; stripe, github and slack need the secret the provider issued.

delete.description: Removes the endpoint and the events it received. Workflows bound to it stop being triggered.

post.description: The old secret stops verifying immediately. A generated secret is returned once in `secret`.

get.summary: Get an execution with every step's input, output and error

post.description: Cancels open steps, pending approval tasks and timers. A step already running on a worker is fenced out: its result is discarded.
Succeeded steps keep their outputs and are not re-run; the failed step and the steps cancelled because of it run again. The execution deadline restarts.
